item.title_tr: K10 Open Ear Headphones with Non-Closed Channel Design Retain External Sound Improves Safety for Ultra Travel
item.description_tr:
🎧 Bluetooth Headphones TWS K10 Ear Clip Open-Ear
✨ Selling Points
✅ Dolby spatial audio with two low frequency drivers, 300% more powerful bass and immersive sound like a cloud
☁️ Only 4.4g in ultralight ear clip, memory titanium alloy stand, all-day comfortable wear
🔇 HD DT noise reduction for clear calls, effectively block ambient noise
⚡ Bluetooth 5.4 Chip with 92% faster pairing and 125% more interference resistance plus low latency for gaming
🔋 Case with LED digital display, 8H of single playback and up to 40H of total duration
🎨 Colors: Metallic Black, Metallic Silver, Metallic Purple

🌍 Usage Scenarios
🏃 Outdoor sports | 💼 Calls in the Office | 🎮 Furniture Games | 🚇 Daily Displacement | 🎵 Casual hearing

📦 Packing list
1 * Pair of K10 Ear Clip Headphones
1 * Charging Case with LED Digital Display
1 * Type-C Charging Cable
1 * User Manual

❓ FAQ
Q: Why don't the headphones turn on initially?
A: The headphones may be in factory deep sleep mode. Charge them for 30 minutes before first use.
